generation.textureGuidanceNote: image = Meshy textures from the reference render (no texture_prompt), which keeps the authored palette; prompt = manifest prompt sent as texture_prompt. The first 11 models of this batch (pilot + priorities 1..10) ran with 'prompt' and the concrete-base turrets came back washed-out white, so the default was switched to 'image' for the rest.
generation.pricingSource: https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/pricing (Smart Topology T2 image-to-3d: 5 untextured / 15 textured)

reference.view: front-right three-quarter, original bake direction 'se' (root z = -90 deg), orthographic camera from the saved .blend

palette: Palette: graphite blue-gray armored steel, pale titanium trim, warm brass details, carbon-black rubber, glowing teal lights, amber warnings, cyan glass. Hard-surface sci-fi military game asset, PBR, no text or logos.

skipped.structural-kit-reason: Modular building kit pieces must keep exact 1x1 cell footprints and flush tiling edges; AI mesh generation cannot guarantee these dimensions, and the authored rough geometry is already final for flat slabs/walls.
skipped.plugin-cards-reason: Fifteen near-identical circuit-board variants (3 geometries x 5 recolors) used as card icons; not worth 225 credits of the 1000-credit budget.
